limitations: Review conducted strictly on static review packet files (rendered PNG captures, source HTML, fixture JSON, checks JSON) without live interactive execution.
Inspection bounded to 32 total file reads; intermediate viewports at 390px were evaluated through checks.json geometry and source media queries rather than dedicated image reads.
No human usability or end-to-end screen-reader testing performed beyond automated assertions and DOM structure analysis.

firstActionSalience.tradeoff: A presents 'Open P-104' alongside an immediate 'Paper on hand' inventory sidebar that divides horizontal attention; B isolates 'Open P-104' in a single-column card list but precedes it with a large editorial hero ('A good place to start.') that pushes the queue down.

decisionContextRetention.tradeoff: A displays current paper stock on the initial queue screen so an operator sees availability before selecting a job, but omits the total stock denominator in review ('95' vs B's '95 of 120' in proofdesk/b/1440-review.png).

errorAndRecoveryClarity.tradeoff: A shifts DOM focus directly to the '#failure' alert on rejection and keeps form submission enabled to surface errors; B includes an on-screen clamp message ('#clamp-message') but disables the review button upon invalid input and skips alert focus on failure.

responsiveAccess.evidence: proofdesk/b/320-initial.png (.thumb object-fit:contain) vs proofdesk/a/320-initial.png (.job img object-fit:cover)
responsiveAccess.tradeoff: B preserves the full uncropped vector proof graphic and stacks buttons cleanly across 320px; A severely crops the SVG proof thumbnail ('-104' truncated). B hides its queue counter ('#job-count') below 800px.

semanticControlAndFocus.tradeoff: A maintains standard form submission with live validation and standard h1->h2->h3 heading hierarchy; B disables native submit buttons on validation failure and uses h2 for job card titles under h1.

contentToThesis.tradeoff: A integrates shop-floor paper availability ('Paper on hand') directly into the primary queue desk view; B defers paper stock visibility entirely until after a job is opened.

suppliedArtifactsShapeComposition.tradeoff: B frames the proof on a 24px grid cutting mat and preserves exact SVG aspect ratios everywhere; A's registration '+' marks are authentic but its queue thumbnail crops the vector graphic on mobile.

coherentMediaTypeDirection.tradeoff: Both variants correctly treat supplied SVGs as 2D vector press proofs with accurate ink and format metadata, avoiding faux 3D skewing or photorealistic distortion.

honestEvidenceLimits.tradeoff: A prominently features 'Local demonstration' in the persistent header and footer across all states; B confines demo limitation notes to body text and omits them from the persistent chrome.

firstActionSalience.evidence: cabinet/a/1440-initial.png and cabinet/a/source.html#L54 vs cabinet/b/1440-initial.png, cabinet/b/320-initial.png
firstActionSalience.tradeoff: A keeps the comparison shelf hidden until an item is pinned, leaving cards and initial open actions unobstructed; B permanently displays an empty sticky comparison shelf that covers card content at the bottom of 1440px and 320px viewports.

decisionContextRetention.tradeoff: A dynamically updates comparison cards upon pin/unpin within the comparison view and names active pins during 3rd-pin rejection; B's comparison view becomes stale if a pin is removed and requires scrolling above an obstructive bottom shelf.

errorAndRecoveryClarity.evidence: cabinet/a/1440-failure.png and cabinet/a/source.html#L55,L58 vs cabinet/b/1440-failure.png and cabinet/b/source.html#L80
errorAndRecoveryClarity.tradeoff: A displays an integrated, single-surface error panel with direct retry and names exact pinned records on third pin; B introduces a 220ms synthetic timeout and renders competing stacked toast banners over the comparison shelf.

responsiveAccess.tradeoff: A provides full viewport clearance for wayfinding cards on 320px screens; B's persistent multi-row shelf consumes approximately one-third of the vertical viewport on mobile.

semanticControlAndFocus.tradeoff: Both variants provide full accessible names, aria-pressed states on pin buttons, role='status' live feedback, and restore focus to the calling card upon return.

contentToThesis.tradeoff: A incorporates sign-mounting screw head motifs on artifact frames and cohesive index labeling ('PANEL INDEX / 06'); B uses varying colored background mats that resemble generic portfolio tiles.

suppliedArtifactsShapeComposition.tradeoff: Both variants prioritize wide horizontal SVG signage graphics above metadata grids; both normalize diverse physical dimensions into fixed aspect-ratio display stages.

coherentMediaTypeDirection.tradeoff: Both variants explicitly caption diagrams as original illustrative graphics rather than physical photographs or scale engineering drawings.

honestEvidenceLimits.tradeoff: Both variants scrupulously disclaim historical authenticity and physical condition in persistent footers, error panels, and intro copy without inventory or checkout drift.

limitations: Evaluations rely on static rendered viewports (1440px and 320px) and DOM source code without live interactive script execution.
File read quota constrained detailed screenshot inspections of intermediate 390px viewports, which were cross-referenced via checks.json metrics.
Visual rendering assessment confirmed pixels were visible in tool outputs; no human usability or assistive hardware tests were conducted.
